TABLE I: Held-out Sleep-EDF benchmark, full budget (mean ± 95% CI, 5 seeds, leave-one-subject-out). Stars mark paired Wilcoxon significance vs. RG-Flow.

FIG. 3: Data-budget crossover. Left: 5-class accuracy vs training epochs per subject for each model (mean ± 95% CI). Right: seed standard deviation of accuracy (lower = more stable). The scarce-data hypothesis predicts the largest RG-Flow advantage at the left edge.

FIG. 4: RG-Flow’s learned γ (mean over layers) versus its out-of-sample β-recovery R2, across the data-budget sweep. A systematic relationship would indicate the internal scale parameter tracks the measured spectral exponent—the interpretability payoff the vanilla model cannot provide.
